summary: Added 41 new events (48 total) after a deep sweep of music, comedy, food, and gallery sources, plus a venue-by-venue pass on Eastside clubs and a check of the parks department calendars. Highlights: a two-day accordion convention at Plaza de la Raza and open studios running all week at the Bendix Building. Archived 4 events that already passed.

events.title: Open Studios Week at the Bendix
events.blurb: Ninety working studios across twelve floors, open all week.

events.title: Cumbia Sonidera Residency
events.blurb: Weekly residency with two sonideros trading sets until close.

events.title: Fog
events.blurb: One projector, one hour, no dialogue.

events.title: Oyster Hour on the Roof
events.blurb: Two-dollar oysters and a shucking demo while the sun goes down behind the Biltmore.

events.title: Deep Cuts: All-Vinyl Disco
events.blurb: Three DJs, no laptops, a room that stays full until last call.

events.title: First Friday Gallery Walk Along Chung King Road and the Surrounding Alleys
events.blurb: Fourteen galleries stay open late along the pedestrian row.

events.title: Open Mic Roulette
events.blurb: Names go into a hat at the door and come out in whatever order the host draws them, five minutes each with no do-overs and no trading slots, which means the room can swing from a polished tight five to somebody's first time on stage.

events.title: Basement Show: Three Bands, One Amp
events.blurb: Local post-punk bill in a room that holds about ninety people.

events.title: Taco Crawl: Boyle Heights Edition
events.blurb: Six stands in four blocks, walking pace, pay as you go.

events.title: Sunset Session on the Water Tower Deck
events.blurb: Golden-hour house sets on a deck that fits two hundred, with the tower lit behind the booth.

events.title: Dawn Hike to Echo Mountain
events.blurb: Five miles up the old incline railway bed, back before the heat.

events.title: The Twenty-Third Annual Eastside Accordion and Button Box Convention: Bellows, Reeds, and Regrettable Decisions
events.blurb: A two-day marathon of accordion, bandoneon, and concertina, with bellows-technique workshops in the morning, an instrument swap meet at noon, and an open orchestra at dusk that anyone who can hold a chord is welcome to join.

events.title: Saturday Growers Market in the North Lot of the Old Santa Monica Airport
events.blurb: Stone fruit is nearly finished for the season and the last of the white peaches are here, alongside the first of the fall squash, three bread bakers, a fish truck that sells out by ten, and the flower stall at the far end of the row.

events.title: Block Party on 6th
events.blurb: The street closes to cars at two in the afternoon and stays closed until nine, with three stages running at opposite ends of the block, a bike valet by the loading dock, and an enormous number of folding chairs that neighbors drag out and share.

events.title: Roller Derby Double Header
events.blurb: Two bouts, one league, cheap beer.

events.title: Sketch Session in the Rose Garden
events.blurb: Bring paper. Someone always brings extra pencils.

events.title: Dim Sum Crawl
events.blurb: Four rooms, carts at all of them, ordered family style.

events.title: Free Legal Clinic, Tenant Counseling, and Neighborhood Resource Fair
events.blurb: Tenant counseling, expungement help, and a notary, all walk-in.

events.title: Silent Film with Live Organ
events.blurb: A 1927 print accompanied on the house Wurlitzer, which has been in the building since it opened.

events.title: Repair Cafe: Bring Something Broken
events.blurb: Volunteers fix lamps, bikes, and small appliances while you wait.

events.title: Monday Jazz Session
events.blurb: The house trio takes the first set on its own and then opens the horn chair to whoever signed the list by the door, which is why the second set is reliably the better one and why the room fills up around eleven.

events.title: New Material Night
events.blurb: Everything on stage is being tried for the first time.

events.title: Tuesday Night Cinema Club: Programmer's Choice on 35mm
events.blurb: Whoever won last week's raffle picks the film, which means the programming swings wildly between restored classics and things that probably should not have been printed, and nobody in the room knows what is screening until the lights go down.

events.title: Roast Battle Qualifiers
events.blurb: Sixteen comics, single elimination, one very tired judge.

events.title: Pupusa Night
events.blurb: Revueltas and loroco made to order on two flat-tops in the parish hall, with curtido pulled from jars that have been fermenting since Tuesday and a line that wraps around the folding tables by seven.

events.title: Ceramics Seconds Sale
events.blurb: Slight warps and glaze runs, priced accordingly.

events.title: Warehouse Techno on the Second Floor: An All-Night Session Somewhere in Vernon
events.blurb: Address goes out to ticket holders at 8 PM the night of.

events.title: Songwriter Circle
events.blurb: Four writers, one guitar passed between them.

events.title: Mutual Aid Grocery Distribution
events.blurb: Bring a bag; boxes go out until they run out.

events.title: Tide Pool Walk at Low Tide
events.blurb: A naturalist points out what the minus tide uncovers.

events.title: Swap Meet and Record Fair
events.blurb: Two hundred sellers, mostly vinyl, some of it good.

events.title: Rose Hill Recreation Center Pickup Basketball League Championship Finals
events.blurb: The rec league final, which gets more heated than it should.

events.title: Supper Club: One Long Table
events.blurb: Six courses served family style to forty people seated at a single reclaimed-timber table in a Frogtown courtyard, with the menu decided the morning of based on whatever looked best at the market and announced only when each course lands.

events.title: Documentary and Director Q&A
events.blurb: Screening followed by a conversation with the director.

events.title: Chamber Music in the Round
events.blurb: A string quartet playing from the middle of the room.

events.title: Storytelling Showcase
events.blurb: True stories, ten minutes each, no notes allowed.

events.title: Printmaking Demonstration and Open Press Night at Self Help Graphics
events.blurb: Watch a full edition get pulled from start to finish on the big flatbed press, then take a turn at the smaller press yourself with plates the studio keeps on hand, with ink, paper, and someone patient enough to explain registration all provided.

events.title: Late Set: Dub and Roots
events.blurb: A late-starting set built around a borrowed sound system that leans heavily on the low end, with long dubbed-out transitions, very little talking between records, and a room that does not really fill up until well after midnight.

events.title: Neighborhood Council Candidate Forum
events.blurb: Candidates answer questions submitted by residents.

events.title: Sunrise Ride to the Observatory
events.blurb: A slow group climb up to Griffith and back down for coffee.

events.title: Midnight Noir Double Feature
events.blurb: Two restored 35mm noirs back to back, with an intro from the archivist.

events.title: Eastside Ceramics Open Studios
events.blurb: Two dozen clay studios open their doors for demos, seconds sales, and kiln tours.

events.title: Autumn Star Party on the Observatory Lawn with Volunteer Astronomers
events.blurb: Volunteer astronomers set up telescopes on the lawn for a new-moon viewing night.

events.title: The All-Night Stand-Up Marathon
events.blurb: Forty comics in six hours, with surprise drop-ins after midnight.

events.title: Harbor Lit Fest
events.venue: Warner Grand Theatre and surrounding blocks
events.blurb: Small-press book fair, panels on West Coast poetry, and a waterfront reading series.

events.title: Dia de los Muertos Community Procession, Altars, and Folklorico on the Plaza
events.blurb: Community altars go up around the plaza in the afternoon and stay lit through the night, a candlelit procession sets off at dusk and loops through the surrounding blocks, and folklorico dancers take the plaza stage once it is fully dark.

events.title: Verdugo Canyon Trail Run
events.blurb: Ten-mile ridgeline course with 2,000 feet of climbing and pancakes at the finish.

events.title: Warehouse Ballet: Fall Program
events.blurb: Three new works staged in the round in a converted garment loft.
